  one_event <- GET(url1)
  details <- content(one_event, "parse")
  artist[i] <- details$name
  genre[i] <- details$classifications[[1]]$genre$name
  venue[i] <- details$`_embedded`$venues[[1]]$name
  time[i] <- details$dates$start$localTime
  date[i] <- details$dates$start$localDate
  ticket_status[i] <- details$dates$status$code
}

ticket_data2 <- tibble(artist, genre, venue, time, date, ticket_status)
ticket_data2

event_information <- function(event_ids) {
  number_of_ids = length(ids)
  artist <- character(number_of_ids)
  genre <- character(number_of_ids)
  venue <- character(number_of_ids)
  time <- character(number_of_ids)
  date <- character(number_of_ids)
  ticket_status <- character(number_of_ids)

for(i in 1:number_of_ids) {
  url1 <- str_c("https://app.ticketmaster.com/discovery/v2/events/",ids[i],".json?apikey=n6u6dP1Mb5C8Hth2yWCYekxMh1tRmFPb")
  one_event <- GET(url1)
  details <- content(one_event, "parse")
  artist[i] <- details$name
  genre[i] <- details$classifications[[1]]$genre$name
  venue[i] <- details$`_embedded`$venues[[1]]$name
  time[i] <- details$dates$start$localTime
  date[i] <- details$dates$start$localDate
  ticket_status[i] <- details$dates$status$code
}

ticket_data3 <- tibble(artist, genre, venue, time, date, ticket_status)
ticket_data3
}
